text: My savings is in a jar under the sink now, because the bank started taking a monthly fee just for me looking at it.
name: Claude Ansel

text: Paid off my credit card last month and the bank mailed to ask if I was okay, which is the most they have checked on me all year.
name: Maybelle Croy

text: My check comes on Fridays, and by Sunday the only part left in it is the part where I find out what it cost.
name: Dee Barnes
